{{DGA awards short description|works-year=2024}}

The '''77th Directors Guild of America Awards''', honoring the outstanding directorial achievement in feature [[Film director|films]], [[Documentary film|documentary]], [[Television director|television]] and [[Television advertisement|commercials]] of 2024, were presented on February 8, 2025, at [[the Beverly Hilton]] in [[Beverly Hills, California]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Davis |first1=Clayton |title=DGA Awards: Sean Baker Wins for ''Anora'', Gaining Major Oscar Momentum (Full Winners List) |url=https://variety.com/2025/film/awards/directors-guild-of-america-awards-2025-winners-1236301530/ |access-date=March 1, 2025 |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |date=February 8, 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Chuba |first1=Kirsten |last2=Lewis |first2=Hilary |title=DGA Awards: Sean Baker Takes Top Honor for ''Anora'' |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/2025-directors-guild-awards-winners-list-1236131036/ |access-date=March 1, 2025 |work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |date=February 8, 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite press release |title=77th Annual DGA Awards Winners |url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2025/250208_77thAnnualDGAAwardsWinners |location=Los Angeles |publisher=[[Directors Guild of America]] |access-date=March 1, 2025 |date=February 8, 2025}}</ref> The ceremony was hosted by [[Judd Apatow]], who previously hosted the [[70th Directors Guild of America Awards|ceremonies in 2018]], [[72nd Directors Guild of America Awards|2020]], [[74th Directors Guild of America Awards|2022]], [[75th Directors Guild of America Awards|2023]] and [[76th Directors Guild of America Awards|2024]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Campione |first1=Katie |title=Judd Apatow Tapped To Host DGA Awards Again; Beth McCarthy-Miller To Serve As Chair For Fourth Consecutive Year |url=https://deadline.com/2025/01/dga-awards-host-2025-judd-apatow-beth-mccarthy-miller-chair-1236264129/ |website=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |access-date=March 1, 2025 |date=January 22, 2025}}</ref> The nominations for the television and documentary categories were announced on January 7, 2025,<ref>{{cite news |last1=Verhoeven |first1=Beatrice |last2=Lewis |first2=Hilary |title=DGA Awards: ''The Bear'', ''Shogun'' and ''The Penguin'' Lead TV Nominations with Three Nods Each |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/2025-dga-awards-nominations-tv-documentaries-commercials-1236103201/ 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite press release |title=DGA Announces Nominees for Outstanding Directorial Achievement in Television, Commercials and Documentary for 2024
